description: Changes one session of the rider's guide, as the app's session screen does: `done` (they rode it), `not_done`, `skip` (not doing it), `unskip`, `move` (to another day, or week), or `change` (its length, distance, effort or description). Use the session's id from `etapa_get_guide`. Only what the rider asked for.

day.description: For `move`: the day, as a name (Thursday) or 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday)

week.description: For `move`: the week, if not its own

name: etapa_update_session
title: Etapa: change a session in the guide
